title: Beginner pandas: Titanic survival by class

# Load the Titanic passenger dataset.
# Goal: practice a categorical groupby and a rate calculation.
df = await load_url('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv')
print(f'loaded titanic: {df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} columns')
print(df.columns.tolist())

cells.code: what was the survival rate by passenger class?
cells.html:
Turn a 0/1 column into a percentage by group
survival_by_class = ( df.groupby('Pclass', as_index=False) .agg(survival_rate=('Survived', 'mean'), passengers=('Survived', 'size')) .sort_values('Pclass') ) survival_by_class['survival_rate'] = (survival_by_class['survival_rate'] * 100).round(1) show_df(survival_by_class)

First-class passengers had the highest survival rate in this dataset. This is a compact example for teaching why the mean of a 0/1 column gives a rate.
